blocks.arabic_text: عَلَي رُفَقَائِكَ، يَا أَكْثَمُ! خَيْرُ اَلرُّفَقَاءِ أَرْبَعَةٌ، وَخَيْرُ السَّرَايَا أَرْبَعُمِائَةٍ، وَخَيْرُ الْجُيُوشِ أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافٍ وَلَنْ يُغْلَبَ إِثْنَا عَشَرَ اَلْفاً مِنْ قِلَّةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه، باب السرايا، رقم: ٢٨٢٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates, “Rasulullah ﷺ said to Hazrat Aktham (RA), “Aktham! Do jihad together with other peoples; if you do so, your character will become excellent.” And through this good character you will be regarded as honourable among your companions. Aktham! Good companions (for a journey) are (at least) four people. The best sariyyah (small detachment) is a force of four hundred people. The best jaysh (large army) consists of four thousand people. An army of twelve thousand people will not be defeated because of the smallness of their number” (however, if they engage in things such as disobedience to Allah Ta'ala, they may be defeated)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ فِي سَفَرٍ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَي رَاحِلَةٍ لَهُ، قَالَ: فَجَعَلَ يَصْرِفُ بَصَرَهُ يَمِيناً وَشِمَالاً، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ فَضْلُ ظَهْرٍ فَلْيُعِدَّ بِهِ عَلي مَنْ لَا ظَهْرَ لَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ فَضْلٌ مِنْ زَادٍ فَلْيُعِدَّ بِهِ عَلَي مَنْ لَا زَادَ لَهُ، قَالَ: فَذَكَرَ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ الْمَالِ مَا ذَكَرَ، حَتَّي رَأَيْنَا أَنَّهُ لَا حَقَّ لأَحَدٍ مِنَّا فيِ فَضْلٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب استحباب المؤاساة بفضول المال، رقم:٤٥١٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates, “Once we were on a journey with Rasulullah ﷺ. At that time a man came riding on his mount, and (with the intention of making his need known) looked to the right and to the left. (He looked around to the right and to the left so that his need would somehow be fulfilled)
